bounded_host_request.command:
set -u
unit=$(systemctl --user list-units --all --type=service --no-legend --plain 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'collect|video|userbot' || true)
printf 'USERBOT_AND_COLLECTION_SERVICES\n%s\n' "$unit"
printf 'G_MOUNT_PRESENT='
mountpoint -q /mnt/g && echo YES || echo NO
printf 'COLLECTOR_PROCESSES\n'
ps -eo pid,etimes,comm | grep -Ei 'python|ffmpeg|userbot' | head -30 || true
printf 'TARGET_DIR_HINTS\n'
find /mnt/g -maxdepth 4 -type d -iname '*nippon*' -print 2>/dev/null | head -10 || true
printf 'COLLECTOR_DIAGNOSTIC_FINISHED\n'
exit 0
